detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: Thorian says, "I know one ritual that utilizes the different arcane strengths of the Veraelian elves and bestows the mix of power upon a bow or an orb." "I only offer this ritual to those who have sufficiently aided the cause of the Celestine Ward, and you seem to have done so." "In order to perform this ritual, I need the energies of the leaders of Thelaseen and the Temple of Vol Tuniel. Slay them, and I will channel their energy to me."

pages.article_html:
Ancient Weapons Of Leth Verael

Level 38 · Adventuring · Shaman's Glade · Thestra

Slay the leaders of Thelaseen and the Temple of Vol Tuniel. Return to Thorian Glowban at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon.

Objectives

- Leaders of Thelaseen (0/5) - Leaders of Vol Tuniel (0/5)

Description

Thorian says, "I know one ritual that utilizes the different arcane strengths of the Veraelian elves and bestows the mix of power upon a bow or an orb." "I only offer this ritual to those who have sufficiently aided the cause of the Celestine Ward, and you seem to have done so." "In order to perform this ritual, I need the energies of the leaders of Thelaseen and the Temple of Vol Tuniel. Slay them, and I will channel their energy to me."

What they say

On offering it

Thorian
I know one ritual that utilizes the different arcane strengths of the Veraelian elves and bestows the mix of power upon a bow or an orb. I only offer this ritual to those who have sufficiently aided the cause of the Celestine Ward, and you seem to have done so. In order to perform this ritual, I need the energies of the leaders of Thelaseen and the Temple of Vol Tuniel. Slay them, and I will channel their energy to me.

Recorded by quest description.

Thorian Glowban
Thorian says, "I know one ritual that utilizes the different arcane strengths of the Veraelian elves and bestows the mix of power upon a bow or an orb." "I only offer this ritual to those who have sufficiently aided the cause of the Celestine Ward, and you seem to have done so." "In order to perform this ritual, I need the energies of the leaders of Thelaseen and the Temple of Vol Tuniel. Slay them, and I will channel their energy to me."

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Notes

This quest opens once you have achieved Celestine Ward full faction of 11,900. You need not have completed any of the Celestine Ward armor to access this quest. This quest was accessible as low as level 30. Vol Tuniel is an underground dungeon one chunk south of Wardship of the Sleeping Moon. Thelaseen is an aerial dungeon situated on elevated platforms and is located one chunk south and one chunk east of Wardship. Refer to a map for locations of named within each.

findings.observation: Current tracker requires Leaders of Thelaseen (0/5) and Leaders of Vol Tuniel (0/5). Screenshot-attributed tracker adds Slain; Curse records Thelaseen (5/5) and Vol Tuniel (0/5). Preserve separate progress snapshots; a completed counter is not an extra objective or a distinct requirement. No individual leader identities are supplied.

Header prints level 38; notes say accessible as low as level 30. Three attributed level disagreements name an operator-pasted screenshot, wiki.silkyvenom.com:80, and Curse before the rescale. These do not resolve a historical minimum level; item required levels are separate.

Notes claim access at Celestine Ward full faction 11,900 and explicitly say armor quests need not be completed. Offering dialogue only says sufficiently aided the Ward. Retain the numerical threshold as a notes claim without inferring an enforced prerequisite from chain navigation.

Starts with and hand-in name Thorian Glowban; offering dialogue also uses Thorian. Starts in Shaman's Glade with location 14063, -18224, 11704; narrative return location is Wardship of the Sleeping Moon. Two starts-zone disagreements attribute mmodb and silkyvenom. Coordinate axes and exact spawn remain unverified.

Chain label is Celestine Ward Weapon Quest, whereas the preceding reviewed quests label Thelaseen Weapon. Related setting and weapons do not establish a single chain identity. Next links this same Ancient Weapons Of Leth Verael page; preserve self-reference without creating a prerequisite cycle. Repeatable prints No.

Coin reward prints 16 without denomination. Rating 7.0 is separately labelled and is not a reward amount. Offering text describes bow or orb ritual, while Rewards additionally includes a shield and multiple tooltips. Choice cardinality and operative reward bundle are unresolved.

Longbow tooltips differ: Verael has 131 damage, +1 ranged accuracy/damage ratings, +38 Archery/Bow/Awareness and +1 critical ranged hit chance; Varael has 152 damage, +36 accuracy and +23 damage ratings, required level 35 and item level 45. Class lists differ too. Shortbow entries likewise differ (132 versus 152 damage). Preserve spelling, class and stat variants without merging or assigning eras.

Orb variants include Annihiliation (+98 Spell Damage Focus and +2 Spell Damage Rating) and Annihilation (+111 Spell Damage Focus); additional Varaetian spellings appear. Healing and Moon And Stars tooltips have distinct labels and classes. These are literal observations, not a resolved canonical item family.

Source links the archived MMODB page at vgoemulator.net. Fandom, Curse and screenshot accounts appear as archive attributions only; no originals or image pixels were fetched or inspected. Mirrored accounts do not provide independent corroboration.
